titleEn: Condo Flooring Renovation in Richmond BC 2026: Real Costs From 3 Recent Projects
titleZh: 列治文公寓地板装修 2026：三个真实项目费用详解
contentEn:
A Richmond condo owner replaced every floor in her high-rise unit for $18,400. The job took nine days, required no permit, and eliminated the creaky original carpet that had bothered her for six years. This article breaks down what she paid, what alternatives cost, and how to plan your own condo flooring renovation in Richmond BC in 2026.

How Much Does Condo Flooring Renovation Cost in Richmond BC?

The total cost for a full condo flooring renovation in Richmond ranges from $9,000 to $42,000 in 2026, depending on material choice and coverage area. A typical 1,100–1,400 sq ft Richmond high-rise condo runs $14,000–$24,000 for a mid-range LVP or engineered hardwood throughout. Tile in wet areas (entry, bathrooms) adds $2,800–$6,000 for materials and labour combined.

Strata approvals are almost never required for flooring replacement — only work that alters the structure or plumbing. Confirm with your building's Strata Council that your chosen material meets the building's finish schedule, particularly for acoustic ratings on floors above other units.

MaterialCost per sq ft (installed)Best for
Luxury Vinyl Plank (LVP)$6–$12/sq ftWater-prone areas, condo acoustics, budget-friendly
Engineered Hardwood$11–$22/sq ftLiving areas, adds real estate value
Porcelain / Ceramic Tile$14–$28/sq ftEntryways, bathrooms, laundry
Carpet (replacement)$4–$8/sq ftBedrooms only

Real Project: 1,100 sq ft Richmond Condo — $18,400 Total

A recent Reno Stars project in a Richmond high-rise covered approximately 1,100 square feet. The scope included engineered hardwood in the living room and bedrooms, LVP in the kitchen and entryway, and porcelain tile in both bathrooms. The entire renovation was completed in nine working days.

Material costs accounted for roughly 55% of the total ($10,100). Labour and installation ran $8,300 (45%). No structural work was required, so no permit was needed. Baseboards were refitted to accommodate the new floor heights — a standard step that must be factored into any condo flooring scope.

Richmond condos typically have concrete subfloors, ideal for both LVP (click-lock, no adhesive) and tile (thinset mortar). The existing carpet was removed and disposed of; the concrete was cleaned and level-checked before the new flooring was installed.

LVP vs Engineered Hardwood for Richmond Condos: Which Is Better?

For most Richmond condo owners, LVP is the more practical choice in 2026 — but engineered hardwood adds measurable resale value that LVP cannot match.

LVP (luxury vinyl plank) is 100% waterproof, click-lock installed over concrete subfloor with no glue required, and qualifies for most condo acoustic underlayment requirements when paired with an IXPE or cork underlayment pad. It is the preferred material for kitchens, bathrooms, and entryways in Richmond condo renovations. A mid-range LVP in a Richmond condo runs $6–$10 per square foot installed.

Engineered hardwood adds warmth and real estate appeal that is particularly valued in Richmond's Asian-majority neighbourhoods where hardwood floors are the expected standard in move-in ready homes. Engineered hardwood resists moisture better than solid hardwood (crucial in Richmond's coastal humidity) and can be refinished once if the wear layer is thick enough. A 3mm wear-layer engineered hardwood in a Richmond condo costs $11–$18 per square foot installed.

The optimal approach for a Richmond condo in 2026: LVP throughout for practical durability, with engineered hardwood in the living room if resale value is a priority. A combined approach covering 1,200 sq ft typically costs $14,000–$22,000 depending on material grade.

Condo Flooring Timeline in Richmond: What to Expect

A full condo flooring renovation in Richmond takes 7–14 working days from material delivery to final walkthrough.

  • Day 1–2: Furniture moving and carpet/flooring removal. Subfloor is cleaned and moisture-tested.
  • Day 3–4: Subfloor levelling if required (self-levelling compound on concrete; ~$400–$900). Underlayment installation.
  • Day 5–9: LVP and hardwood click-lock installation. Tile work in bathrooms simultaneously.
  • Day 10–11: Grouting, sealing, and grout cure time for tile.
  • Day 12–13: Baseboard refitting. Final trim and transitions.
  • Day 14: Final clean, punch list, and walkthrough.

Richmond Strata buildings typically require proof of insurance and a deposit (refundable, $500–$2,000) before work begins.

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home or commercial renovation? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars.

What Drives Condo Flooring Costs Up in Richmond

Three factors most commonly increase the price of a Richmond condo flooring renovation beyond the initial estimate:

  • Uneven subfloor: Richmond high-rise condos built before 2010 frequently have subfloor height variations of 5–15mm. Self-levelling compound adds $400–$900 per room.
  • Asbestos in existing flooring: Buildings constructed before 1990 may contain asbestos in the original mastic or vinyl sheet flooring. Testing is $150–$300; abatement runs $1,500–$8,000. Reno Stars includes asbestos screening in every pre-construction agreement for buildings built before 1990.
  • Strata access restrictions: Some Richmond condo buildings restrict work to business hours (8am–5pm) or prohibit weekend work entirely, adding 2–4 days to the timeline.

A Delta whole-house renovation completed by Reno Stars included new LVP flooring in the kitchen and entry alongside a full kitchen renovation — illustrating how flooring pairs with other renovation work for a cohesive result. See Delta kitchen and two-bathroom renovation.

Condo Flooring Renovation Richmond BC: Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need a permit for condo flooring renovation in Richmond?

No. Replacing flooring in a Richmond condo does not require a municipal permit. However, if your renovation involves moving plumbing fixtures or altering the concrete subfloor structurally, a permit is required. Confirm with your Strata Council before starting.

What is the best flooring for a Richmond condo?

Luxury vinyl plank (LVP) is the most practical choice for most Richmond condos in 2026 because it is waterproof, quiet underfoot with acoustic underlayment, and installs directly over concrete without glue. For living rooms where resale value matters, engineered hardwood is the preferred upgrade. Porcelain tile is standard in entryways and bathrooms.

How long does a condo flooring renovation take in Richmond?

A full condo flooring renovation takes 7–14 working days. A smaller project (kitchen and bathrooms only) finishes in 5–7 days. Tile requires grout cure time that LVP and hardwood do not.

Will new flooring increase my condo's resale value in Richmond?

New engineered hardwood or high-quality LVP is consistently cited by Richmond Realtors as one of the highest-ROI improvements before listing. Updated flooring that meets current buyer expectations can add $15,000–$30,000 to the final sale price of a typical 1,200 sq ft unit.

What acoustic requirements do Richmond condos have for flooring?

Most Richmond condo Strata bylaws require acoustic underlayment (IIC 65 / STC 50 minimum) for hard-surface flooring above another unit. Reno Stars specifies IXPE or cork underlayment as standard with all LVP and engineered hardwood installations, satisfying the acoustic requirements of virtually all Richmond Strata corporations.
contentZh:
列治文一位公寓业主更换了整个高层单位的地面，花费18,400加元。工程历时九天，无需许可证，彻底解决了困扰她六年之久的吱呀作响的原装地毯。本文详细分解她的花费、不同方案的费用，以及2026年如何在列治文规划自己的公寓地板装修。

列治文公寓地板装修多少钱？

2026年，列治文公寓全屋地板装修总费用在9,000至42,000加元之间，取决于材料选择和施工面积。典型的列治文高层公寓（面积1,100–1,400平方尺）选用中档LVP或工程实木地板，全屋费用约14,000–24,000加元。湿区（入口、浴室）铺瓷砖，材料及人工合计增加约2,800–6,000加元。

地板更换几乎不需要业主委员会审批——仅涉及结构改动或管道改动的工程才需要审批。开工前请确认您选用的材料符合大楼的装修规定，尤其是楼上单位的地板隔音等级要求。

材料安装费（每平方尺）最佳适用区域
豪华乙烯基塑料板（LVP）$6–$12/平方尺防水区域、公寓隔音需求、预算友好
工程实木地板$11–$22/平方尺客厅、提升房产价值
瓷质/陶瓷砖$14–$28/平方尺入口、浴室、洗衣房
地毯（更换）$4–$8/平方尺仅限卧室

真实项目：列治文1,100平方尺公寓 — 总费用$18,400

Reno Stars近期在列治文一栋高层公寓的项目覆盖约1,100平方尺。工程范围包括客厅和卧室铺设工程实木地板，厨房和入口铺设LVP，两个浴室铺瓷质砖。整体装修在九个工日内完工。

材料费用约占总费用的55%（$10,100）。人工及安装费用$8,300（45%）。无需结构工程，因此无需申请许可证。踢脚板根据新的地板高度进行了调整——这是所有公寓地板工程中必须考虑的步骤。

列治文公寓通常为混凝土基层，非常适合LVP（锁扣式，无需胶水）和瓷砖（薄层砂浆铺贴）。原有地毯被拆除并处理；混凝土基层在铺设新地板前已清洁并进行平整度检测。

规划厨房、浴室、全屋或商业装修？联系 Reno Stars 获取免费、无义务的报价。

列治文公寓：LVP还是工程实木地板？哪种更好？

对于大多数列治文公寓业主，2026年LVP是更实用的选择——但工程实木地板能带来LVP无法比拟的房产转售价值提升。

LVP（豪华乙烯基塑料板）100%防水，锁扣式铺装在混凝土基层上无需胶水，配合IXPE或软木隔声垫可满足大多数列治文公寓的隔音要求。中档LVP在列治文公寓的安装费用为每平方尺$6–$10。

工程实木地板带来温暖感和房产吸引力——在列治文以华裔居民为主的社区，实木地板是move-in ready房屋的预期标准。工程实木地板比纯实木更能抵抗潮湿（在列治文的沿海潮湿气候中至关重要），如果耐磨层足够厚还可以打磨一次。列治文公寓选用3mm耐磨层工程实木地板，安装费用为每平方尺$11–$18。

2026年列治文公寓的最佳方案：全程使用LVP保证耐用性，客厅升级为工程实木地板以提升转售价值。覆盖1,200平方尺的组合方案，费用通常在$14,000–$22,000之间，取决于材料等级。

列治文公寓地板装修时间线：预期多久？

列治文公寓全屋地板装修从材料进场到最终验收需要7–14个工作日。

  • 第1–2天：搬移家具，拆除原有地毯/地板。清洁基层并进行湿度检测。
  • 第3–4天：基层找平（如需要，自流平找平：约$400–$900）。安装隔声垫。
  • 第5–9天：LVP和实木地板锁扣铺设。浴室瓷砖同步施工。
  • 第10–11天：瓷砖填缝、密封和养护。
  • 第12–13天：调整踢脚板。过渡条收尾。
  • 第14天：最终清洁和验收。

列治文分契式大楼通常要求提供保险证明和押金（可退还，$500–$2,000）后方可开工。

规划厨房、浴室、全屋或商业装修？联系 Reno Stars 获取免费、无义务的报价。

哪些因素会增加列治文公寓地板装修费用？

三个因素最常见地会让列治文公寓地板装修费用超出最初预算：

  • 基层不平：2010年前建造的列治文高层公寓，基层高度差通常达到5–15毫米/房间。自流平找平材料每房间增加$400–$900。
  • 现有地板含石棉：1990年前建造的建筑，原有胶粘剂或乙烯基卷材可能含石棉。检测费用$150–$300；石棉处理费用$1,500–$8,000（取决于范围）。Reno Stars在每份1990年前建筑的前期合同中均包含石棉筛查条款。
  • 分契大楼作业限制：部分列治文分契式大楼限制施工时间为工作日（上午8点–下午5点），或完全禁止周末施工。这些限制可能使项目时间延长2–4天。

Reno Stars完成的三角洲全屋装修项目，在全新LVP地板（厨房和入口）的同时完成了整体厨房装修——展示了地板工程如何与其他装修工作自然搭配。查看完整项目：三角洲厨房及两浴室装修。

列治文公寓地板装修常见问题

列治文公寓地板装修需要许可证吗？

不需要。列治文公寓更换地板无需申请市政许可证。但如果装修涉及移动卫生洁具或对混凝土基层进行结构性改动，则需要许可证。开工前请确认装修符合大楼管理条例。

列治文公寓最佳地板材料是什么？

豪华乙烯基塑料板（LVP）是2026年大多数列治文公寓的最实用选择，防水、隔声效果好、可直接铺装在混凝土基层上。对于注重转售价值的客厅，工程实木地板是首选升级。瓷质砖是入口和浴室的标准选择。

列治文公寓地板装修需要多长时间？

全屋地板装修需要7–14个工作日。小型项目（仅厨房和浴室）通常在5–7天内完成。瓷砖需要填缝养护时间，而LVP和实木地板不需要。

新房地板装修能增加列治文公寓的转售价值吗？

全新的工程实木地板或高质量LVP是列治文地产经纪普遍认可的上市前最高投资回报改进之一。符合当前买家预期的装修通常能为典型1,200平方尺单位额外增加$15,000–$30,000的销售价格。

列治文公寓对地板有哪些隔音要求？

大多数列治文分契大楼规定，硬质地板铺装于另一单位上方时，必须使用隔声垫（最低IIC 65 / STC 50）。Reno Stars在所有LVP和工程实木地板安装项目中将IXPE或软木隔声垫作为标准配置，可满足几乎所有列治文分契公司的隔音要求。
